title: Funny creepers
description: Funny Creepers is a texture pack that turns scary creepers into funny and weird ones with goofy faces, making Minecraft more fun while keeping the explosions!
body:
Funny Creepers 

A texture pack that gives Minecraft creepers a hilarious twist!
Instead of the usual scary creepers, you’ll encounter funny, weird, and totally messed-up face

* Creepers with exaggerated expressions
* Strange eyes and goofy faces
* A funny look instead of a scary one
* Perfect for adding humor to your game

This pack is great for anyone who loves Minecraft but wants a lighter, more entertaining experience.

 Warning: They may look funny… but they still explode! 

---

 Great for:

* YouTube videos 
* Playing with friends 
* Making your game more fun

Try it out and watch creepers turn into a joke!
